overview: November combined survey-scale catalogues with simulation-based and generative inference. Euclid DR1 produced strong-lens catalogues and segmentation pipelines; DESI DR1 photometry fed normalizing-flow tomographic N(z), while SBi3PCF and the FAIR Universe challenge addressed weak-lensing inference. Benchmarks included COSMIO cross-survey imputation and the Agentic Observer hackathon. Neural surrogates and operators covered MHD turbulence, rotating neutron stars, supernova equations of state and compact-binary waveforms; LLM pipelines produced dark-matter and galaxy-discussion registries, and Survey of Surveys DR3 homogenised nine spectroscopic surveys.
